name: Drive Them Out
summary: Baine Bloodhoof asks you to clear the Galak centaurs from the village’s path. Their defeat could give the children a measure of safety.

sections.title: The Galak
sections.body: Six Galak centaurs and four Galak outrunners must fall, and Herak the Pillager’s head must come back to Baine. The village’s safety is at stake.

sections.title: A Village’s Relief
sections.body: Baine hears the last centaur fall and the stampede cease. He calls it a great victory for the village. Its children need that feeling of safety more than ever.

faq.q: Who asks me to drive off the Galak?
faq.answer: Baine Bloodhoof asks you to confront the Galak centaurs and outrunners. He also asks you to bring him Herak the Pillager’s head.

faq.q: What does Baine want from me?
faq.answer: Kill six Galak centaurs and four Galak outrunners for Baine, then bring him Herak the Pillager’s head.
Herak the Pillager is a Galak whose head Baine asks you to bring.

faq.q: Why does this matter to the village?
faq.answer: Baine says victory gives the village’s children a feeling of safety they need more than ever.

angles.text: As a tauren, Baine calls the bloodshed a unique honor among your people.

attribution: In-game quest text: Drive Them Out
